findings.evidence: Roadmap README lines 206–207 requires a “genuine `def` ... hence computable”; the implementation at line 24 explicitly says `noncomputable def`.
findings.fix: Define the sum using an explicitly computable finset of elements whose conjugacy class equals `C`, and remove `noncomputable`.
findings.issue: `classSum` is declared `noncomputable`, contradicting the roadmap’s required computable definition on finite decidable group data.

findings.evidence: `Suggested.lean` lines 76–77 pins `classSum` under `[Semiring k]`; line 24 inherits `[CommRing k]` from line 21.
findings.fix: Give `classSum` a `[Semiring k]` signature and retain stronger coefficient assumptions only on centrality results where needed.
